Genuine GAPS found (small but real): (1) readying your OWN asset/card — Galvanize 60121, no 'ready' tag exists for the player side; (2) an extra ATTACK within a single card's resolution ('fight again') — One-Two Punch 60117/60132, distinct from gaining an action; (3) 'does not provoke attacks of opportunity' — Mano a Mano 60125, a discrete searchable benefit with no home; (4) playing/putting a searched card DIRECTLY INTO PLAY from deck/discard — Randall Cho 60102, where DeckSearch covers the fetch but not the cheat-into-play destination.

Ambiguities/judgment calls flagged for synthesis: (a) Relentless (60109) stores 'excess damage' on itself as counters then converts to resources — I tagged only the GainResource aspect; a dedicated 'place-excess-damage-as-counter' or 'convert-stored-damage' tag felt too niche from a single card, but flag it if it recurs. (b) Boxing Gloves' 'add it to your hand' (60105/60127) is the default search destination, so I did NOT propose a search-destination argument for the to-hand case; only the to-PLAY case (60102) is novel. (c) Whether ActionAdditionalAttack belongs in action/additional.ts as a variant or a new attack/ folder is a structural choice left to the maintainer — I placed it in the existing additional file. (d) Counterpunch's 'even if that attack was canceled' wording (60112) is a corner-case enabler not separately tagged.

proposedTags.rationale: Zoey's Cross (90060): '[fast] Remove 2 [bless] tokens from the chaos bag: Engage an enemy at your location.' This is adding/removing bless or curse tokens TO/FROM the chaos bag (bag composition manipulation), which is the engine of the entire bless/curse archetype. The existing chaos folder only has effect.ts, reveal.ts, seal.ts — none of which express modifying the bag's bless/curse population. This effect ('add N [bless]/[curse] tokens' / 'remove N [bless]/[curse] tokens') recurs heavily across fhv/tic/tsk/tdc. A user building a bless or curse deck searches exactly for cards that grow/shrink the bag. token + value are optional filters; the searchable thing is 'manipulates bless/curse count'.

Tidal Memento (90038): 'release a [bless] or [curse] token sealed on that enemy' and 'Resolve a [bless] or [curse] token sealed on an enemy instead.' The existing ChaosSeal enum covers sealing token-0/any/auto-fail/cultist/elder-sign/elder-thing/skull/tablet but deliberately OMITS bless and curse. Bless/curse sealing-and-releasing is now a distinct, searchable bless/curse-deck mechanic. Adding ChaosSealTokenBless and ChaosSealTokenCurse variants to the existing seal file fills that omission with the existing argument-free pattern.

Tidal Memento (90038): '...when a chaos token would be revealed from the chaos bag: Resolve a [bless] or [curse] token sealed on an enemy instead.' This is the inverse of sealing — RELEASING/resolving an already-sealed token in place of a bag draw. No existing tag expresses 'release/resolve a sealed token'. It is a recurring chaos-control trick (sealing engines spend the sealed tokens for control). Distinct from ChaosSealToken* (which means 'this card seals') and from ChaosRevealAnotherInstead (which is reveal-from-bag substitution, not sealed-token release).

On the Lam (90009): 'you may disengage from each engaged enemy and move up to 2 locations away.' There is NO disengage tag — and the existing tagged-cards file (rcore.ts) contains explicit TODO comments '// disengage - Need tag type' on Elusive, Cat Burglar, and the evasion-success rider, proving this is a known unfilled gap. 'Disengage from each enemy engaged with you' is the core of the evasion/escape package (On the Lam, Elusive, Cat Burglar, Ethereal Form, Gate Box, Cheat Death) and a primary deckbuilding search. Belongs as a new variant in the existing enemy/engage.ts enum alongside EnemyEngageNone.

Daisy's Tote Bag (90002): 'When you play a [[Tome]] asset during your turn, exhaust Daisy's Tote Bag: That asset gains fast.' Directive (90026): 'When you play an [[Insight]] or [[Tactic]] event, exhaust this Directive: That event gains fast.' Granting the fast keyword to a just-played card is a distinct tempo-enabling mechanic appearing 6+ times across packs (also Chuck Fergus x2, Fence, Cryptic Grimoire). The existing cost/fast.ts tags describe a card that IS fast, not a card that GRANTS fast to OTHER cards — no existing tag fits. Searchable for tempo/action-compression builds. cardType/trait are optional filters; the searchable concept is 'makes my other cards fast'.

proposedTags.suggestedName: TagTypeSlotAdditional restriction argument (add optional 'restrictedToTrait' field to SlotAdditional* base)
proposedTags.rationale: Daisy's Tote Bag (90002): 'You have 2 additional hand slots, which can only be used to hold [[Tome]] assets.' The existing SlotAdditionalHand captures 'extra hand slot' but drops the load-bearing restriction that the slot is trait-locked. Per the rubric (add an argument when the broad aspect is searchable and the detail is an optional filter), an optional restrictedToTrait field on the SlotAdditional base lets users find 'extra Tome-only slots' (relevant for Tome/Spell-slot synergy investigators) without a new tag.

Zoey's Cross (90060): '[reaction] After you engage an enemy, exhaust Zoey's Cross and spend 1 resource: Deal 1 damage to that enemy.' The taxonomy tracks specific action-triggers (TimingAfterSuccessfullyInvestigate, TimingWhenDefeatEnemy) but has no 'after you engage an enemy' trigger. This is the search hook for engage-synergy builds (Zoey, Roland directives) and recurs ~4x across packs. Moderate-confidence proposal, consistent with existing selective timing-after tags.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that participate in the bless/curse token economy: adding/removing bless or curse tokens to/from the chaos bag, sealing or releasing bless/curse tokens, and reacting to bless/curse token reveals. The defining build-around for Bless and Curse decks.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Players who build bless or curse decks search for ALL cards that touch the bless/curse subsystem as a group, regardless of whether the card adds, removes, seals, releases, or triggers off the token. This pack has Zoey's Cross (90060, removes bless to engage), Tidal Memento (90038, releases/resolves sealed bless or curse, reacts to bless/curse reveal), and Jim's Trumpet (90050, reacts to curse reveal). The reveal-token variants already exist; the add/remove/seal-bless-curse pieces are proposed above. Grouping them as a compound captures the archetype.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that get you out of melee: disengaging from engaged enemies, auto-evading, testless evade, and self-relocation to break engagement. The evasion/escape package.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: On the Lam (90009): 'disengage from each engaged enemy and move up to 2 locations away' and Trusty Bullwhip (90063): 'automatically evade the attacked enemy.' Evasion-focused investigators (Skids, Wendy, Finn) search for the whole escape toolkit together — disengage + auto/testless evade + self-move all serve the same 'get away clean' purpose. The disengage base tag is proposed above; AutoEvade, TestlessEvade, and LocationMoveInvestigatorSelf already exist. This is a recurring cross-pack archetype (Elusive, Cat Burglar, Ethereal Form).

archetypes.name: Investigator signature/advanced replacement cards
archetypes.description: Every card in pak 'par' is a 'X deck only' Advanced / Permanent / Replacement signature asset or event for a specific investigator (Daisy, Skids, Agnes, Roland, Wendy, Pete, Jim, Zoey, Monterey, Rex). Effects are highly bespoke and almost all carry deck_restriction. They span clue-tech, fight weapons, evasion, healing, and chaos-token control.

archetypes.name: Bless/Curse token economy
archetypes.description: Cards that add/remove bless or curse tokens, seal/release them, or trigger off their reveal. The build-around engine of bless and curse decks; currently only the reveal-token side is taxonomized.

archetypes.name: Evasion / escape package
archetypes.description: Disengaging from all engaged enemies, auto/testless evade, and self-relocation to break melee. Disengage is currently untaggable (known TODO in source).

archetypes.name: Tempo: grant-fast enablers
archetypes.description: Permanents/assets that give the fast keyword to other cards you play (by trait), compressing actions. No existing tag expresses granting fast to another card.

coverageNotes:
Pack 'par' is 17 card entries (15 unique cards plus the flip side 90052b; 90052/90052b counted). The existing taxonomy already covers the bulk of these cards well: deck_restriction (DeckRestriction) on nearly every card; weapon/fight cards Roland's .38 Special (90030) and Trusty Bullwhip (90063) via bold-fight, StatsModBoostInTest*, DamagePlus, AutoEvade, and UsesStartingAmmo/UsesSupportAmmo(place) for self-replenishing ammo; Trusty Bullwhip's 'uses [agility] instead of [combat]' via BuffStatsReplace{from,to}; reaction/exhaust/spend-resource costs via Cost* tags; chaos-token REVEAL triggers (skull/curse/elder-sign/etc.) on Jim's Trumpet (90050), Tidal Memento (90038), The Beyond (90052b) via ChaosReveal*; healing (HealHorror*/HealDamage*) on Pete's Guitar, Jim's Trumpet, The Beyond; draw (DeckDrawYou/Player) on Heirloom (90018), Directive (90028), Search for the Truth (90079); gain-resource on Pete's Guitar; enemy displacement (LocationMoveEnemyDisplace) on Pete's Guitar; non-Elite-only restriction (EnemyEliteNonEliteOnly + CannotAttackYou) on On the Lam; +skill-value-per-condition on Directive 90025 via StatsModBoostInTest (dynamic) + EnemyEngageWithYou; 'play events from discard pile' on Wendy's Amulet (90039) via RecursionEvent (confirmed precedent in rcore.ts) plus DiscardPileToBottomDeck; +3 sanity Directive (90029) is a static stat bonus intentionally not given a dedicated tag.

GENUINE GAPS (proposed above): (1) adding/removing bless or curse tokens to/from the chaos bag — Zoey's Cross 90060; no chaos-bag-composition tag exists. (2) sealing AND releasing bless/curse tokens — Tidal Memento 90038; the ChaosSeal enum deliberately omits bless/curse and has no 'release sealed token' concept. (3) DISENGAGE from each engaged enemy — On the Lam 90009; confirmed unfilled (explicit '// disengage - Need tag type' TODOs in rcore.ts). (4) grant-fast-to-another-card — Daisy's Tote Bag 90002, Directive 90026; recurs 6+ times across packs. (5) optional trait-restriction argument on additional slots — Daisy's Tote Bag 90002. (6) 'after you engage an enemy' timing trigger — Zoey's Cross 90060 (moderate confidence).

AMBIGUITIES / borderline I did NOT propose to stay conservative: Search for the Truth (90079) 'Place that clue on your location' moves a clue off the investigator card onto a location — plausibly LocationMoveClue but slightly off-pattern; the 'return any card from your discard pile to your hand' is DiscardPileToHand. The Beyond (90052/90052b) spirit-deck attach subsystem (attach top card of a separate spirit deck, flip-and-resolve) is a unique bespoke engine I treated as too card-specific to tag; only its ChaosReveal* token resolutions are taggable. Daisy's Tote Bag 'damage/horror from player card effects only' (90018 Heirloom similar: 'Only damage and/or horror from player card effects can be assigned') is a damage-assignment restriction with no existing tag — flagged but not proposed (rare, and arguably an enabler rather than a searched mechanic). 'Move up to 2 locations away' distance is folded into LocationMoveInvestigatorSelf rather than a new distance tag.

args.name: action
args.type: TestingBasicAction (optional) — the specific action that is exempted from AoO, when the card only protects one action (e.g. engage, investigate, play)

proposedTags.rationale: 'does not provoke attacks of opportunity' is an extremely common, distinctly searchable safety clause with no existing tag. Examples in this pack: Lantern (03036) '[action] Discard Lantern: Deal 1 damage... This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.'; Trench Knife (03147) 'Engage actions you perform do not provoke attacks of opportunity.'; Mano a Mano (03229) 'This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.'; Archaic Glyphs (03193) 'This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.'; also 03189, 03309. The optional action arg distinguishes blanket protection (Trench Knife on engage) from a single ability's protection.

args.name: withoutExhaust
args.type: boolean (optional) — true when the enemy is disengaged but NOT exhausted (e.g. Stealth keeps the enemy ready), which is the unusual searchable variant

proposedTags.rationale: Forcibly disengaging an enemy is a core evasion-tech effect with no existing tag (the enemy/engage folder only covers engage states, not break-engagement). Stealth (03028) 'disengage with it but do not exhaust it'; Snare Trap (03199) 'disengage it from all investigators'; Cheat Death (03310) 'Disengage from each enemy engaged with you'; I'll see you in hell! defeats rather than disengages but disengage appears 3x here. The withoutExhaust arg flags the Stealth-style variant.

The enemy/debuff file already holds EnemyDoesNotReady and EnemyCannotMoveIntoLocation but lacks 'cannot engage you', a recurring evasion-lock effect. Stealth (03028) 'Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you.' This is a sibling debuff that belongs in the same file and would join the enemy-field-control archetype.

Forcing an enemy to exhaust (a tempo/lockdown effect) has no tag. Snare Trap (03199) 'Forced - After a non-[[Elite]] enemy enters attached location: Exhaust that enemy...'. Belongs in enemy/debuff alongside EnemyDoesNotReady (Snare Trap also prevents readying, which IS covered, but the initial exhaust is a separate searchable beat). Recurring archetype across packs (Mind Wipe, etc.).

args.name: action
args.type: TestingBasicAction (optional) — the action during which the secondary stat is added (investigate, fight, evade)

proposedTags.rationale: Adding a SECOND stat's value on top of your skill value for a test is distinct from buff/stats-replace (which swaps a stat) and from boost (a flat +N). Lockpicks (03031) 'Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this investigation.'; Cheap Shot (03194) 'Add your [agility] value to your skill value for this attack.'; Suggestion (03268) 'Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt.'. This 'double-stat' effect is a recognizable archetype players seek (off-stat enablers). Sibling enums for each stat (Combat/Intellect/Willpower) mirror the boost-in-test family.

Acting at a location other than your own ('as if you were there') is a recurring search target with no tag. In the Know (03027) 'Investigate. Investigate any revealed location in play as if you were at that location.'. The rules call this 'as if you were at that location'. Distinct from clue/location tags because it is the act of remote investigation itself. Pairs with RemoteMove and RemoteCommit below as a remote-action archetype.

Committing cards to skill tests performed by investigators at OTHER locations is a defining multiplayer-support effect, untagged. Analytical Mind (03010) 'You may commit 1 card to each skill test performed by an investigator at another location.'. Belongs to the remote-action family and the support archetype.

Moving to any revealed location (non-adjacent teleport-style movement) is distinct from location/move tags which move investigators between connecting locations. Astral Travel (03034) 'Move. Move to any revealed location...'; Cheat Death (03310) 'move to any revealed location with no enemies'. Recurring fast-travel archetype.

args.name: value
args.type: number (optional) — printed health/soak amount; omit when conditional like Composure

proposedTags.rationale: Damage soak (an asset that absorbs damage as an HP buffer) is a foundational asset role with no tag. Cherished Keepsake (03114) and the Composure cards (Combat Training 03107, Scientific Theory 03109, Moxie 03111) all read 'Non-direct horror must be assigned to X before it can be assigned to your investigator card.'; True Grit (03021) and Key of Ys (03315) soak damage. The regex layer already distinguishes soak_benefit_damage vs soak_conditional, confirming the concept's prevalence. Cross-pack 'soak package' archetype.

Horror soak (sanity buffer) mirrors damage soak and is equally fundamental. Combat Training (03107), Scientific Theory (03109), Moxie (03111), Plucky (03115), Grounded (03113) — all Composure cards: 'Non-direct horror must be assigned to [card] before it can be assigned to your investigator card.'; Key of Ys (03315) 'Forced - When any amount of horror would be placed on you: Place 1 of that horror on Key of Ys.'. Distinct stat (sanity) from SoakDamage; both feed a soak archetype.

Taking an attack/hit aimed at another investigator ('instead of') is a distinct defender/aggro-control archetype, not covered by soak (which absorbs your own damage) or cancel. Heroic Rescue (03106) 'Engage that enemy and resolve its attack against you instead.'; True Grit (03021) 'may be assigned damage dealt to other investigators at your location.'. Pairs with TankRedirectEncounter.

Taking another investigator's encounter card for them is a signature protector effect with no tag. 'Let me handle this!' (03022) 'Play after another investigator draws a non-peril encounter card... You are considered to have drawn that encounter card, instead.'. Same protector archetype as TankRedirectAttack; searchable by players building a 'guardian/tank' deck.

args.name: source
args.type: string (optional) — 'charge' | 'engaged-enemy' etc., what scales the granted icons

proposedTags.rationale: A committed skill card that GAINS extra skill icons (often [wild]) based on a variable is a recognizable 'icon generator' archetype with no tag (skill-value tags cover succeed/fail margins, not icon granting). Torrent of Power (03235) 'For each charge spent in this way, Torrent of Power gains [willpower] [wild].'; 'Not without a fight!' (03272) 'For each enemy engaged with you, ...gains [willpower] [combat] [agility].'. Members for wild and per-stat icon gains.

Putting an asset/card directly into play from hand (cheating it in, distinct from cost discounts) is a recurring tempo archetype. Sleight of Hand (03029) 'Put an [[Item]] asset into play from your hand.'. The cost/discount tag captures cost reduction but not the 'put into play' mechanic itself. Pairs with PutIntoPlayFromDiscard.

Putting a card into play (or playing a copy) from a discard pile is a distinct recursion/value archetype not captured by discard-pile/main (which only returns cards to hand/deck). A Chance Encounter (03238) 'Put that asset into play under your control.' (from any player's discard); Eidetic Memory (03306) 'Play Eidetic Memory as an exact copy of an [[Insight]] event in any investigator's discard pile'. Cross-pack 'play-from-discard' value engine.

'Remove from the game' as a self-cost/effect is a distinct one-shot mechanic (separate from exile, which is a deckbuilding XP mechanic). Quantum Flux (03196) 'Remove Quantum Flux from the game.'; The Painted World (03012) 'Remove The Painted World from the game instead of discarding it.'; Seal of the Elder Sign (03312) 'remove Seal of the Elder Sign from the game.'; Cheat Death (03310) 'Remove Cheat Death from the game.'. Players search for non-recurring/one-time cards via this.

Exile (rules p.980, removes the card from your deck/collection permanently, with repurchase implications) is a deliberate campaign/deckbuilding mechanic distinct from rfg-self. A Test of Will (03156) 'Exile A Test of Will.'; Devil's Luck (03157) 'Exile Devil's Luck.'. Players actively filter for exile cards when planning XP. Worth its own category given the digest has a 'testless' category for similarly cross-cutting concepts.

args.name: comparison
args.type: 'min' | 'max' — whether the card needs at-least or at-most that much remaining sanity

proposedTags.rationale: Many cards gate or scale on the investigator's own current resource/sanity/horror/clue/hand state, with no tag for these self-state thresholds. Say Your Prayers / Desperate Search / Reckless Assault / Run For Your Life (03116-03119) 'Commit ... only if you have 3 or fewer remaining sanity.'; Anatomical Diagrams (03108) 'Play only if you have 5 or more remaining sanity.'. This 'low-sanity / horror-payoff' (Survivor/Mystic) archetype is searchable. Sibling condition tags would cover horror (Fight or Flight 03155 'X is the amount of horror on you'), resources (Dario 03151 '10 or more resources'), clues, and empty hand (Madame Labranche 03198).

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that help slip past or neutralize enemies without killing them: forced disengage, enemy-cannot-engage, testless/auto evade, exhausting enemies, and AoO-immunity that enables safe maneuvering.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Evasion-focused decks search for the whole toolkit at once. This pack alone has Stealth (03028, disengage + cannot-engage + -evade), Snare Trap (03199, exhaust + disengage), Cheap Shot (03194, auto-evade), Archaic Glyphs (03193, auto-evade), and several no-AoO actions. AutoEvade/TestlessEvade already exist; the new disengage/exhaust/cannot-engage tags complete the cluster.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that let one investigator absorb or take on harm meant for others — soaking damage/horror, redirecting attacks, and taking another player's encounter card.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Guardian/defender deckbuilders want every 'take the hit for the team' tool together. Heroic Rescue (03106) redirects attacks, 'Let me handle this!' (03022) takes encounter cards, True Grit (03021) and the Composure suite (03107/03109/03111/03113/03115) and Key of Ys (03315) soak. These currently share only loose regex hints (tank_*, soak_*).

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that generate, multiply, or convert into resources beyond a flat gain — 'big money' engines and payoffs.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: A recurring 'big money' archetype: David Renfield (03112) 'Gain 1 resource for each doom', Dario El-Amin (03151) gains resources and pays off at 10+, 'Watch this!' (03233) 'gain twice that many resources', Alchemical Transmutation (03032) scaling resource gain, Emergency Cache (03239), Madame Labranche (03198). gain/resource already exists; this compound names the cross-pack economy archetype for later synthesis and would also pull in the proposed ConditionResourceThreshold payoffs.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that let you investigate, move, commit, or otherwise act at a location other than your own ('as if you were there'), enabling action-at-a-distance and multiplayer support.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: In the Know (03027, remote investigate), Astral Travel (03034) / Cheat Death (03310) (move to any revealed location), and Analytical Mind (03010, remote commit) all share the 'act elsewhere' mechanic and are sought together by Seeker/support builders. Distinct enough from existing location tags to warrant grouping.

archetypes.name: Evasion / enemy lockdown
archetypes.description: Slipping past or neutralizing enemies without defeating them: forced disengage, cannot-engage debuff, exhausting enemies, auto/testless evade, and no-attack-of-opportunity maneuvering. Strongly represented in this Rogue/Survivor-heavy pack.

archetypes.name: Protector / tank (soak + redirect)
archetypes.description: One investigator absorbs harm for the team: Composure soak suite (horror), damage soak (True Grit, Key of Ys, Cherished Keepsake), and attack/encounter redirection (Heroic Rescue, 'Let me handle this!').

archetypes.name: Off-stat / stat-substitution skill tech
archetypes.description: Cards that add a second stat to a test (Lockpicks, Cheap Shot, Suggestion), replace a stat (Storm of Spirits uses willpower for fight), or grant extra skill icons on commit (Torrent of Power, 'Not without a fight!').

archetypes.name: Resource / big-money economy
archetypes.description: Resource-generation engines and payoffs: David Renfield (doom-for-money), Dario El-Amin (10+ payoff), 'Watch this!' (doubling), Emergency Cache, Madame Labranche, Alchemical Transmutation.

archetypes.name: Discard/play recursion and one-shot removal
archetypes.description: Value via the discard pile and permanent removal: play/put-into-play from discard (A Chance Encounter, Eidetic Memory, The Painted World), return-to-hand from discard (Resourceful, True Survivor), plus exile and remove-from-game self mechanics.

archetypes.name: Chaos-token control
archetypes.description: Manipulating the chaos bag/reveals: reveal-more-and-choose ('Eat lead!'), manual reveals tied to non-test effects (Recharge, Alchemical Transmutation), and seal/treat-as-elder-sign (Seal of the Elder Sign). Largely already covered by existing chaos tags.

coverageNotes:
Analyzed all 99 player cards (03007-03315). The digest IS the complete taxonomy (every tags/src/tags/**.ts file is present in it; the JSON's 'tags' are regex hints, many of which—tank_*, soak_*, remote_*, exile, rfg_self, disengage, stat_add_*, skill_gains_*, current_*, not_aoo, to_play_from_*—have NO backing tag and are exactly the gaps above).

WELL-COVERED already (do not re-propose): bold actions (action/bold), additional actions (action/additional handles Guidance 03265 and .41 Derringer 03234 'take an additional action'), cancels (cancel/main covers Forewarned/Ward of Protection revelation cancels, Devil's Luck damage/horror, Infighting/Narrow Escape/Suggestion attack), chaos reveal/seal/effect (covers Alchemical Transmutation, Storm of Spirits, Recharge manual reveal, 'Eat lead!' reveal-more+resolve-choose, Seal of the Elder Sign do-not-reveal/treat-as-elder-sign), uses starting/support and charge/supply manipulation (Book of Shadows add-charge, Spirit-Speaker charge→resource via uses-support move, Recharge, Emergency Cache place-supply), cost families (action/fast/free/reaction discard/exhaust/spend, and CostActionSpendResource covers ammo/secret/charge/supply costs), discount (Ever Vigilant, Uncage the Soul, Charles Ross, Sleight-of-Hand cost reductions), draw/search/shuffle (No Stone Unturned, Eureka!, Calling in Favors, Arcane Initiate, On the Hunt encounter search, Stick to the Plan), discard-pile→hand/deck (Resourceful, True Survivor, Quantum Flux), recursion by type, doom add/check (David Renfield, Arcane Initiate), gain-resource with value, heal damage/horror you/investigator/ally (First Aid, Inspiring Presence, Logical Reasoning), location/move (LocationMoveClue covers Forewarned clue placement and The Home Front 'move 1 damage'—LocationMoveDamage), enemy/mitigation defeat (Waylay, I'll see you in hell!), enemy/elite (non-elite-only), engage states, testless damage/clue/evade, skill-value succeed/fail-by, test/initiate, duration, timing (when/after/forced/phase), traits, slots, attach, damage-plus.

AMBIGUITIES / judgment calls flagged for synthesis:
1. STAT REPLACEMENT vs STAT ADD: buff/stats-replace (from/to) plausibly already covers Storm of Spirits (03153) 'uses [willpower] instead of [combat]'—so I did NOT propose a replace tag; but 'Add your [agility] value to your skill value' (Lockpicks/Cheap Shot/Suggestion) is ADDITIVE and genuinely uncovered, hence StatsModAddStat. Confirm the replace tag is intended for in-test substitution before relying on it.
2. CONSTRAINTS likely intentionally untagged: 'Limit 1 [[Composure]] in play', 'Once per turn' (.41 Derringer/Arcane Insight), 'Max 1 committed per skill test', 'Play only as your first action' (Mano a Mano)—I treated these as deliberately-omitted constraints and did NOT propose tags, matching the digest's 'obvious-from-text not tagged' policy. Flag if constraints are wanted.
3. CAMPAIGN/growth effects: victory display (Bury Them Deep 03016), bonus XP (Charon's Obol 03308), 'researched'/'unidentified' customizable states (Archaic Glyphs) are campaign-layer, not gameplay mechanics for find-similar; left untagged.
4. Minor one-offs not proposed (too unique for cross-pack reuse): Time Warp (03311) action-undo; 'ignore the retaliate keyword' (.45 Automatic 03190)—recurring on weapons but narrow; clue-drop 'place 1 of your clues' (Forewarned 03150)—borderline, arguably under location/move.
5. The new categories proposed (remote, soak, tank, exile, rfg, condition, play, skill-commit) follow the digest's pattern of cross-cutting single-concept folders (cf. 'testless'); folder/file names are suggestions—align with existing naming if a closer home exists.

proposedTags.rationale: "This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity" appears on Dynamite Blast (50002): "Deal 3 damage to each enemy and to each investigator at the chosen location. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity." and on Lantern (52009) second ability. This is a discrete, very commonly-searched mechanic (a huge number of player cards carry it as a safety clause for testless/engaged actions) and NOTHING in the current taxonomy expresses it. Suggest its own small file/category (it is action-safety, not a true testless effect, so a dedicated 'aoo' folder may be cleaner than nesting in testless).

Trial by Fire (54010): "Until the end of your turn, set the base value of each of your skills to 5, or the base value of one of your skills to 7." SETTING a base skill value is mechanically distinct from the existing stats-mod boosts (which add/subtract) and from BuffStatsReplace (which swaps one stat for another). A deckbuilder searching for 'fix a bad stat / guarantee a value' wants this specifically. No existing tag fits.

Archaic Glyphs (52004): "If you succeed, you may put an asset with printed cost of X or lower into play from your hand." Cheating a card directly into play from hand (bypassing its play cost) is a distinct, searched tempo/economy effect. Existing PlayArea tags only cover play-area-to-hand / play-area-to-deck (the opposite direction). Recurring archetype across the game (e.g. later 'put into play' assets).

Hallowed Mirror (54002): "Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Soothing Melody..." and Occult Lexicon (54004): "Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of Blood-Rite...". Searching the BONDED set (not your deck/discard/encounter deck) is a distinct zone the existing DeckSearch tags (you/investigator/discard/encounter) do not cover. This is the defining mechanic of the bonded-card archetype that recurs heavily in later packs (Miss Doyle, etc.).

The Star • XVII (54001): "Each asset you control with health gets +1 health. Each asset you control with sanity gets +1 sanity." Boosting the health/sanity (durability) of your assets is a discrete support effect with no existing tag (stats-mod tags cover skill values only; heal tags restore damage/horror but do not raise max health/sanity). Sibling variant BuffAssetSanity should accompany it.

Alter Fate (53009): "Choose and discard from play a non-weakness treachery that is not attached to an [[Elite]] enemy." The existing CancelRevelation / CancelEncounterEffect / CancelEncounterDraw tags all fire WHEN a card is drawn. Removing a treachery that is ALREADY in play (an ongoing/attached treachery) is a separate, searched cleanup effect with no current tag.

Suggestion (52006): "Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt." This ADDS a second stat on top of the test's normal stat (effective stat-doubling), which is different from BuffStatsReplace ('X instead of Y', e.g. Rite of Seeking 51007, Mists of R'lyeh 53007, Storm of Spirits 52008). Replace is covered; additive 'use stat A in addition to stat B' is not.

Moon Pendant (54012): "You have 1 additional tarot slot." and Observed (54013) interacts with the tarot deck/slot. The SlotAdditional enum currently lists Accessory/Ally/Arcane/Hand but not Tarot; adding the Tarot variant keeps parity with the existing per-slot tags.

The Hierophant • V (54007): "Your arcane slots can be used to hold cards that take up accessory slots, and vice versa." Letting one slot type substitute for another is a distinct deckbuilding-flexibility effect not expressible by the existing additive SlotAdditional tags (which only grant new slots).

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards whose primary purpose is generating a large burst or steady stream of resources (the 'big money' economy engine players build around for expensive assets / resource-payoff cards).
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Hot Streak (50006): "Gain 10 resources." is the canonical big-money card; Strange Solution (51004) and Decorated Skull (53005) also generate resources. A deckbuilder searching 'resource acceleration / big money' wants these grouped. Currently GainResource is only a flat per-card tag with a value; the archetype grouping is missing. (value-based filtering, e.g. >=5, would let synthesis distinguish true big-money from incidental +1.)

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards built around the evade action and its support: evading, disengaging without exhausting, lowering enemy evade, preventing re-engagement, and moving after evading.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Stealth (52005): "Evade. The chosen enemy gets -2 evade... disengage with it but do not exhaust it. Until the end of your turn, that enemy cannot engage you."; Suggestion (52006) and Mists of R'lyeh (53007) are evade-action assets; these form a recognizable evasion toolbox. 'enemy cannot engage you' / 'disengage without exhausting' is itself an uncovered sub-effect worth flagging for a future base tag.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that manipulate the chaos bag / token reveal: sealing tokens, revealing extra and choosing/ignoring, or keying off which symbol is revealed.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: The Chthonian Stone (53008) seals skull/cultist/tablet/elder_thing; "Eat lead!" (52002): "reveal 1 additional chaos token. Choose one to resolve and ignore the other."; Rite of Seeking (51007) / Storm of Spirits (52008) key off revealed symbols. These chaos-bag-tech cards are searched together but the taxonomy has no umbrella compound grouping them.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that trigger a benefit (charges, resources, draw) when an enemy/ally/investigator is defeated at your location — a 'reap value from defeats' engine.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Decorated Skull (53005): "[reaction] After an investigator, [[Ally]] asset, or enemy at your location is defeated: Place 1 resource on Decorated Skull, as a charge. [action] Spend up to 3 charges: Draw that many cards and gain that many resources." The defeat-triggered accrual engine is a recurring archetype; flagging it lets later packs (e.g. Hunter's Armor, trophy cards) join the group. Note: the existing TimingWhenDefeatEnemy does not capture 'ally/investigator defeated', which may warrant broadening.

archetypes.name: Stat-pip pump assets (1-resource skill boosters)
archetypes.description: The classic class skill assets that let you repeatedly spend 1 resource for +1 to a pair of stats during a test. Fully covered by existing stats-mod-boost-in-test tags; listed only to confirm taxonomy size.

archetypes.name: Willpower-instead spell weapons/tools
archetypes.description: Spell-trait cards that perform Fight/Investigate/Evade using willpower instead of the normal stat, often with a downside on bad chaos symbols. Covered by BuffStatsReplace + bold-action + chaos-reveal tags.

archetypes.name: Tarot openers (put into play from opening hand)
archetypes.description: Tarot assets with a passive deckbuilding buff and a 'when the game begins, if in opening hand, put into play' reaction. Covered by TimingGameBegins; the put-into-play-from-opening-hand is implicit. The per-card passive buffs vary (see new buff/slot proposals).

archetypes.name: Bonded summon engines
archetypes.description: Limit-1 assets that fetch their bonded payload cards into hand/deck and upgrade them when played. Drives the new DeckSearchBonded proposal.

archetypes.name: Discard-to-finish weapons/tools (remove-from-game upgrade)
archetypes.description: Assets with a sustained action plus a 'discard this (or remove from game for more) to do X' finisher. Self-discard covered by discard-from-play / cost tags; the remove-from-game escalation is incidental.

coverageNotes:
Pack rt is the Revised Core / early-cycle reprint set (50 player cards: 5 classes' level-0 staples plus the tarot/bonded line). The existing taxonomy already covers the BULK of it well: per-stat in-test boosts (Physical Training/Hyperawareness/Hard Knocks/Arcane Studies/Dig Deep — stats-mod-boost-in-test), bold actions + combat/willpower boosts + damage-plus on weapons (.32 Colt, Blackjack, Survival Knife, Colt Vest Pocket, Gravedigger's Shovel), uses/ammo/charge/secret economies, discard-zero-uses (Suggestion), 'X instead of Y' stat replacement (BuffStatsReplace covers Rite of Seeking/Mists/Storm/Blood Eclipse), chaos reveal-symbol triggers and sealing (Chthonian Stone, Eat lead!), resource gain (Hot Streak/Strange Solution), card draw (Preposterous Sketches/Contraband/Strange Solution), shroud reduction & extra-clue (Lantern), testless damage (Dynamite Blast via testless-damage tags), fast/free/reaction costs, cost discounts (The Fool, On Your Own — CostDiscount amount), additional slots (Bandolier hand, Sign Magick/Hierophant arcane), non-Elite enemy restrictions (Barricade — EnemyCannotMoveIntoLocation, elite tags), enemy evade reduction (Stealth — EnemyValueEvadeReduction), and secret placement onto assets (Truth from Fiction — UsesSupportSecret place). 

GENUINE GAPS proposed above: (1) 'does not provoke attacks of opportunity' — high-frequency game-wide, completely unrepresented; (2) set-base-skill-value (Trial by Fire); (3) put-asset-into-play-from-hand (Archaic Glyphs); (4) search-bonded-cards (Hallowed Mirror/Occult Lexicon); (5) buff asset health/sanity (The Star); (6) discard a treachery already in play (Alter Fate — distinct from on-draw cancels); (7) additive 'add stat A to skill value' (Suggestion, vs replace); (8) tarot slot + (9) slot-type conversion (Hierophant). 

AMBIGUITIES / JUDGMENT CALLS I could not fully resolve: (a) Mind Wipe (50008) 'treat its printed text box as if it were blank (except Traits)' and 'reduce damage and horror values by 1' — 'blanking an enemy's text box / disabling abilities' has no tag; EnemyValueDamage/Horror exist but carry no value or direction argument, so the -1 reduction is only loosely taggable. I did NOT propose a tag here to stay conservative, but flag enemy-blank/disable as a candidate if it recurs. (b) Well Connected (54006) '+1 skill value for every 4 resources you have' scales off resources you HOLD (not spend) — StatsModPumpResource is spend-based, so this passive resource-count scaling is arguably uncovered; left unproposed pending a second example. (c) Ancient Stone (53004) 'When you draw any number of cards... Move that many times' is testless movement triggered by drawing — movement-on-draw; no clean existing tag, but too singular to propose now. (d) Knight of Swords (54005) '+1 skill value when you would succeed' — treated as covered by stats-mod-boost-in-test-any. (e) Bandolier/Backpack 'slot restricted to a trait' (hand slot for Weapons only) — current SlotAdditionalHand has no trait-restriction argument; could become an optional arg if it recurs.</coverageNotes>
</invoke>

proposedTags.rationale: The dominant, highly searchable Survivor archetype in this pack is the play/reaction window 'after you fail a skill test'. No existing timing tag captures this trigger. tags/timing/after.ts only has enemy-attack and successfully-investigate triggers; tags/skill-test-condition (SkillTestConditionFail) gates an effect on the result of a test rather than tagging the fail-as-trigger reaction window. Examples: Rabbit's Foot '[reaction] After you fail a skill test, exhaust Rabbit's Foot: Draw 1 card.'; Grit Your Teeth 'Fast. Play after you fail a skill test.'; Live and Learn 'Fast. Play after a skill test you failed ends'; Take Heart 'If this test fails, the performing investigator draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources.'

Multiple cards in this pack exile themselves (a removed-from-game mechanic with deckbuilding/campaign relevance, and the defining mechanic of the Stella exile package). No exile tag exists anywhere in the taxonomy. Cherished Keepsake 'Forced - When Cherished Keepsake is defeated by horror: Exile it.'; Leather Coat 'Forced - When Leather Coat is defeated by damage: Exile it.'; A Test of Will 'test [willpower] (3). If you fail, exile A Test of Will.' Note: distinct from discard-from-play because exile removes the card from the game / collection.

Repeating/re-attempting a failed skill test is a distinct, powerful, searchable effect with no existing tag (initiate.ts only starts a NEW named test; skill-value/test-result only describe margins). Live and Learn: 'Attempt that test again. You get +2 skill value for this test.' This is the seed of a recurring 'second chance / re-test' archetype.

Cancelling the consequences/effects of a (failed) skill test is not covered by the existing cancel variants (CancelAttack, CancelChaos, CancelDamage, CancelEncounterDraw, CancelEncounterEffect, CancelHorror, CancelRevelation). Neither Rain nor Snow: 'If this skill test fails, cancel all effects of the failed test.' This is a recurring Survivor 'negate the penalty of failing' effect that pairs with the fail-forward package.

No campaign/experience tag exists. Déjà Vu reduces the XP cost to repurchase exiled cards: 'In between two scenarios of a campaign, reduce the experience cost to repurchase up to 3 cards that you exiled during the last scenario by 1 each.' This is a searchable deckbuilding enabler specifically supporting the exile archetype.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: The 'benefit when you fail a skill test' Survivor archetype: cards that trigger off, reward, mitigate, or re-attempt a failed skill test. Players deckbuild this as a cohesive package and search it as one mechanic.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Nearly the entire Stella pack is built around failing skill tests on purpose. Rabbit's Foot ('After you fail a skill test: Draw 1 card'), 'Look what I found!' ('Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while investigating. Discover 2 clues'), Oops! ('Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less while attacking'), Dumb Luck ('Play after you fail a skill test by 2 or less during an evasion attempt'), Take Heart ('If this test fails... draws 2 cards and gains 2 resources'), Live and Learn ('Attempt that test again'). This is the canonical Survivor 'fail forward' archetype and should be groupable across packs. Note the existing 'fail-by' compound only groups the margin tags; this broader archetype also needs the fail-timing trigger and result tags.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that exile (remove from game) — either self-exiling assets/events or campaign effects that cheapen repurchasing exiled cards — which players build around as a recurring strategy.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: The Stella pack introduces a deliberate exile sub-theme: durable exile-on-defeat assets (Cherished Keepsake exiles when defeated by horror; Leather Coat when defeated by damage), self-exiling events (A Test of Will exiles on failure), and Déjà Vu which exists solely to reduce the XP to repurchase exiled cards. These are searched together as an 'exile engine'.

archetypes.name: Fail-forward (benefit on failure)
archetypes.description: The core Stella Clark / Survivor identity: deliberately failing skill tests to trigger rewards (draw, clues, resources, damage redirection, evasion mitigation) or to re-attempt the test. Triggered by an 'after you fail a skill test' window, often gated on a fail margin ('by 2 or less'). Recurs across all Survivor releases.

archetypes.name: Exile engine
archetypes.description: Self-exiling durable assets/events plus campaign support to cheaply repurchase exiled cards. A small but recurring sub-strategy that players intentionally assemble.

archetypes.name: Failure-mitigation support (ally fail-fixers)
archetypes.description: Allies/effects that intervene at another investigator's fail window to soften or shift the outcome (heal on fail, nudge the fail/skill margin up or down). Granny Orne and Grimm's Fairy Tales seed this 'help the table survive failure' support archetype.

coverageNotes:
Pack 'ste' (Stella Clark starter, 25 cards including upgraded variants) is overwhelmingly a single-mechanic pack: 'benefit when you fail a skill test'. ALREADY WELL COVERED by the existing taxonomy: Uses/ammo/supply/secret/key starting+support (.18 Derringer, Chainsaw, Grimm's Fairy Tales, Old Keyring); per-skill stat boosts in-test and pump-by-resource (Scrapper boost_combat/agility, .18 Derringer boost_combat); damage-plus on attacks (Chainsaw, Derringer); cost-reaction-exhaust-self (Granny Orne, Grimm's, Rabbit's Foot); fast_play / timing-during-your-turn (Will to Survive et al.); draw/gain-resource with values (Take Heart, Lucky!, Rabbit's Foot); deck-restriction (Neither Rain nor Snow); chaos-do-not-reveal (Will to Survive); enemy-mitigation-back-to-encounter-deck (Dumb Luck, top vs bottom is the only nuance lost); discover-clue tags ('Look what I found!'); testless clue/evade; initiate willpower test (A Test of Will); cancel-revelation (A Test of Will). The fail-MARGIN itself ('fail by 2 or less') is covered by SkillValueFailByOrLess and the fail-by compound.

TRUE GAPS (proposed above): (1) the 'after you fail a skill test' TIMING TRIGGER is the single biggest gap — it is the defining searchable thing and is not the same as SkillTestConditionFail (a result-gate) nor any timing/after trigger; (2) EXILE has zero coverage despite three self-exilers and a dedicated XP-repurchase enabler; (3) RE-ATTEMPT a failed test (Live and Learn) is unique and unrepresented; (4) cancel-all-effects-of-a-failed-test (Neither Rain nor Snow) is a cancel target not in the cancel folder; (5) campaign/XP repurchase discount (Déjà Vu) has no home.

AMBIGUITIES I could not fully resolve: (a) Granny Orne ('fails by either 1 less or 1 more', '+1 or -1 skill value') and Quick Learner ('+1/-1 difficulty to your own tests') are skill-value/difficulty MODIFIERS that don't cleanly fit StatsModBoostInTest (which is +X to a named skill, not a bidirectional/difficulty knob) — possible future 'skill-value-modify' or 'difficulty-modify' tag, but I held off as it's only ~2 cards. (b) Oops! redirects 'this attack's damage to a different enemy' — a damage-redirection effect with no existing tag; too niche here to propose confidently but worth watching for a future 'redirect-damage' archetype. (c) Grit Your Teeth '+1 to each of your skills for the remainder of the round' I treated as covered by StatsModBoostInTestAny + a duration tag; flag if 'all skills' should be distinguished from 'any single skill'.</coverageNotes>
</invoke>

proposedTags.rationale: Deny Existence (05032/05280) lets you ignore an effect that would cause you to 'lose actions'; no existing cancel variant covers losing actions. The cancel/main.ts enum has CancelDamage, CancelHorror, CancelEncounterEffect, etc., but nothing for the action-loss aspect. Users searching for protection against action-loss treacheries need this. 05032: 'Discard cards from hand, lose resources, lose actions, take damage, or take horror... You ignore that aspect of the effect.'

Same Deny Existence pair (05032/05280) can ignore the 'lose resources' aspect of an encounter/attack effect. No existing cancel tag covers resource loss. Pairs with CancelLoseAction as the resource-protection counterpart. 05280 additionally REVERSES it (ignore then gain resources), but the cancel/ignore aspect itself is the searchable hook.

Deny Existence (05032/05280) can also ignore the 'Discard cards from hand' aspect. Existing DeckDiscard tags model an effect that DISCARDS; there is no tag for cancelling/ignoring a forced hand-discard. This is the third aspect-protection variant alongside CancelLoseAction/CancelLoseResource and completes the 'modular ignore' coverage.

Well Connected (05028): 'You get +1 skill value for this skill test for every 5 resources you have.' Money Talks (05029): base skill value 'equal to half the number of resources in your resource pool.' This is the 'big money' archetype where skill value scales off your resource pool — distinct from StatsModPumpResource (which scales per resource SPENT) and from passive flat boosts. The 'per' arg captures the denominator (5 for Well Connected, 2 for Money Talks).

Trial by Fire (05281): 'Choose one of your skills. Until the end of your turn, set the base value of that skill to 5.' Setting a base skill value to a fixed number is mechanically distinct from additive boosts (StatsModBoost*) and pumps — it overwrites the base. No existing tag expresses a fixed-base override. The value arg holds the target number (5).

Hallowed Mirror (05313) and Occult Lexicon (05316): 'After [card] enters play: Search your bonded cards for 3 copies of [X]. Add 1 to your hand and shuffle the other 2 into your deck.' Searching the set-aside bonded pile and seeding copies into hand/deck is its own search target distinct from DeckSearchYou/Discard/Encounter, which only cover deck/discard/encounter zones. The bonded-engine archetype recurs (Hallowed Mirror/Soothing Melody, Occult Lexicon/Blood-Rite here).

Double, Double (05320): 'After you play an event... Play that event again as if it were in your hand.' Dayana Esperence (05279) and Knowledge is Power (05231) similarly enable replaying/extra resolutions of events/asset abilities. This is distinct from RecursionEvent (which returns events from the DISCARD pile to play) — here the event is replayed in-place. A recognizable 'free replay' value engine worth its own tag under recursion.

"You owe me one!" (05319): 'Look at another investigator's hand. You may play a non-weakness card in that investigator's hand, under your control.' Twilight Blade (05013) plays events/skills from BENEATH Diana, Dayana (05279) plays an attached event. Playing a card from a zone other than your own hand (another player's hand / under another card) is not captured by any existing tag; PlayArea tags only move cards out of play. A distinct 'borrow / off-hand play' mechanic.

Glimpse the Unthinkable (05318): 'Shuffle any number of non-weakness cards from your hand into your deck. Draw cards until you reach your maximum hand-size.' Studious (05276) also manipulates opening-hand size. 'Draw up to maximum hand size' is a variable bulk-draw distinct from the fixed-value DeckDrawYou (which requires a numeric value). The draw amount is dynamic (fill to cap), so it needs its own variant rather than a value arg.

Steadfast (05022), Curiosity (05026), Cunning (05030), Prophesy (05034), Able Bodied (05038) all read 'While [you have X resources/cards/health/doom...], [card] gains [icons] (while [higher threshold], gains more, instead).' These threshold-scaling skill cards currently receive ZERO tags (empty arrays in input). The 'conditional / threshold icon' skill is a well-known deckbuilding archetype with no existing representation. The condition arg can record the resource/card/health/doom basis.

Grisly Totem (05119/05194/05195): 'After you commit a card to a skill test, exhaust Grisly Totem: That card gains another instance of one of its skill icons of your choice.' Adding an icon to an already-committed card is a distinct commit-support effect not covered by any boost tag (which target the investigator's skill value, not committed-card icons). Recurring upgradeable engine card.

Investments (05233): place supplies on it, then 'Move all supplies from it to your resource pool, as resources.' Family Inheritance (05011): resources accumulate then move to pool. .45 Thompson reprint (05186): 'Ammo spent... is placed in your resource pool, as resources.' Banking/storing value on a card to later convert to resources is an economy archetype distinct from GainResourceYou (immediate flat gain). Worth a tag so 'big money' value-banking cards are findable.

Anna Kaslow (05283): 'You have 2 additional tarot slots.' The slot/additional.ts enum has Accessory/Ally/Arcane/Hand variants but no Tarot variant; only the generic SlotAdditional would apply, losing the trait filter that the other variants deliberately preserve. Sign Magick (05112) similarly grants a trait-restricted arcane slot. Adding the Tarot variant keeps slot tagging consistent and searchable by slot type.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Resource-economy ('big money') cards: those that convert, bank, or scale off a large resource pool — generating bulk resources, storing value to cash in later, or turning resource count into skill value.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: tcu is a major 'big money' pack (Preston/Rogue support): Well Connected (05028) and Money Talks (05029) turn resources into skill value; Investments (05233), Family Inheritance (05011), Another Day Another Dollar (05278), Crack the Case (05110), Hawk-Eye evidence (05154) bank/generate resources. Players deckbuild the resource-economy archetype as a unit, so a compound grouping resource-generation, resource-banking and resource-as-skill tags lets them be found together.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that manipulate the chaos token / skill-test resolution layer: reacting to symbol reveals, cancelling/re-resolving token effects, treating bad tokens as elder sign, or revealing tokens manually.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: tcu is the Mystic symbol-payoff pack: Wither (05157/05321), Sixth Sense (05158/05322), Banish (05113) all key off [skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing] reveals; Eldritch Inspiration (05033) cancels-or-doubles a symbol effect; Eucatastrophe (05324) treats a bad token as elder sign; Henry Wan (05155) reveals tokens manually for value. These individually-tagged chaos primitives form one recognizable 'token control / symbol payoff' deck archetype players search together.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Self-protection cards that selectively ignore/cancel one chosen aspect of an incoming encounter or attack effect (damage, horror, lose actions, lose resources, discard from hand) rather than cancelling the whole card.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: Deny Existence (05032/05280) is the archetypal 'choose one aspect to ignore' card spanning discard/lose-resources/lose-actions/damage/horror; 'I've had worse...' (05315) and Delay the Inevitable (05021) cancel damage/horror specifically. Grouping the per-aspect cancel/ignore tags gives a single searchable 'modular mitigation' archetype that recurs across the survivor/protection card pool.

archetypes.name: Mystic chaos-symbol payoff
archetypes.description: Spells and effects that trigger bonus effects when a [skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing] (or [auto_fail]) symbol is revealed during their test, or that re-resolve/cancel symbol effects. The defining Rylan/Mystic engine of this pack.

archetypes.name: Resource 'big money' economy
archetypes.description: Cards that flood resources, bank value on a card to cash in later, or convert resource count into skill value / payoffs. Preston- and Rogue-flavored economy package.

archetypes.name: Modular self-protection / aspect-ignore
archetypes.description: Survivor-style cards that cancel or ignore a single chosen aspect of an incoming bad effect (damage, horror, lose actions/resources, hand discard), sometimes reversing it into a benefit.

archetypes.name: Bonded value engines
archetypes.description: Permanent/limit-1 cards that seed bonded cards into deck and hand on entry and reclaim them on leave, providing a renewable supply of a specific event (Soothing Melody / Blood-Rite).

archetypes.name: Threshold conditional skills
archetypes.description: 0-cost skill cards that grant extra skill icons while a state threshold is met (resources, cards in hand, remaining health/sanity, doom, items controlled), with a higher tier 'instead'.

archetypes.name: Card-replay / off-hand play
archetypes.description: Cards that replay an event in-place, play events from non-hand zones (beneath an investigator, attached, another player's hand), or ignore an asset's costs to resolve its ability.

coverageNotes: Analyzed all 67 cards (codes 05007-05040, 05109-05119, 05151-05160, 05186-05196, 05229-05237, 05273-05283, 05313-05324). EXISTING TAXONOMY ALREADY COVERS WELL: chaos-token reveal symbols (Wither/Sixth Sense/Banish/Eldritch Inspiration all map to ChaosRevealToken* + chaos-reveal-token-auto-fail/elder-sign); treat-as-elder-sign (Eucatastrophe 05324 = ChaosEffectTreatAsElderSign, confirmed against rcore 01692); cancel-or-resolve-again (ChaosEffectResolveChoose); manual token reveal (Henry Wan 05155 = ChaosRevealManual); deck draw/search/discard-pile manipulation (Scroll of Secrets 05116/05188/05189, Mr. Rook 05153 = DeckSearchYou); event recursion from discard (De Vermis Mysteriis 05235, Dayana 05279 partly = RecursionEvent); fast/uses/exhaust/discard costs; stat boosts in-test and passive (boost_combat/willpower/etc.); damage-plus and testless damage (Mk1 Grenades 05273, Small Favor 05277, Blood-Rite 05317); heal damage/horror you/investigator/ally (Soothing Melody 05314, Hypnotic Therapy 05007); gain resource; enemy move/displace (Banish/Warning Shot 05229/Bait and Switch 05282 = LocationMoveEnemyDisplace); elite-unusable; additional actions (Ace of Rods 05040, Swift Reflexes 05156 = ActionAdditional); additional slots (Sign Magick 05112 = SlotAdditionalArcane); attach; trait-support (Detective's Colt tools, Telescopic Sight firearm). GAPS proposed above. AMBIGUITIES: (1) Hawk-Eye Folding Camera (05154) uses 'evidence' resource tokens placed on the card as a scaling buff source — UsesStartingEvidence exists but the place-on-self-as-evidence-then-buff pattern straddles uses + resource-bank; flagged for synthesis. (2) Knowledge is Power (05231) / Dayana (05279) 'ignore all costs to resolve an ability' could merit its own cost-ignore tag but I folded it into the replay/off-hand-play archetype rather than proposing separately (conservative). (3) Council's Coffer (05196) group deck/discard tutor-and-play is unusual (each investigator searches and plays free) — partially fits DeckSearch but the 'play immediately at no cost for everyone' aspect is unrepresented; left unproposed as a one-off. (4) Mystifying Song (05018)/Fortune or Fate (05237) interact with doom/agenda advancement (DoomRemove/DoomCheck exist for the latter); 'prevent agenda from advancing this phase' has no tag but is rare — not proposed.

proposedTags.rationale: Readying your own/another in-play asset (or ally) is a recurring action-economy effect with NO existing tag. The only 'ready' concepts in the taxonomy are EnemyDoesNotReady (enemy debuff) and the upkeep phase-timing tag. Examples: Bulwark (11028) 'Cancel that attack. Ready another asset you control.'; Inspiring Presence (11029) 'ready an [[Ally]] asset at your location and heal 1 damage and 1 horror from it'; Luger P08 (11050) 'Replenish all ammo on Luger P08 and ready it.' The broad searchable thing is 'this card readies an asset'; the target is an optional filter.

'inspiration' is a use/resource-token type not present in the UsesStarting enum (which only has ammo, charge, supply, secret, evidence). Book of Verse (11005) 'Uses (1 inspiration)' and Artistic Inspiration (11034) 'Uses (1 inspiration)'. Both also spend inspiration to buy +/-1 skill value after revealing chaos tokens, making the token type itself searchable. A matching UsesSupportInspiration is also needed for Mortar/Replenish-style placement. (Sibling additions for the new use types 'shell' on Mauser Tankgewehr 11119 'Uses (1 shell)' and 'leads' on On Their Heels 11120 'Uses (5 leads)' belong in the same UsesStarting/UsesSupport enums.)

Playing a card DIRECTLY from the discard pile (cast straight from discard, not first moved to hand) is not expressible. Existing Recursion* returns a card type to hand/deck, and DiscardPile* moves discard cards to hand/deck — neither captures 'playable from discard.' Profane Idol (11085) 'Profane Idol can only be played from your discard pile.'; Improvised Weapon (11092) 'You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile.'; A Glimmer of Hope (11090) 'can only be played from your discard pile.' This is a recurring discard-value archetype.

Dynamically sealing a chaos token that was REVEALED during a skill test is distinct from the static Seal keyword. The existing ChaosSeal* enums are organized by the pre-specified token TYPE sealed at enter-play (0, any, autofail, cultist, etc.), per the Seal keyword rule. These cards instead remove whatever bad token came out of the bag mid-test, permanently thinning it: Ocula Obscura (11009) 'Seal a non-symbol token revealed during this skill test on Ocula Obscura'; Dial of Ancients (11046) 'Seal 1 chaos token revealed during that test on Dial of Ancients.' This is searchable chaos-bag-control tech.

Activating an asset's printed [action] ability while the card is still IN YOUR HAND (discarding it instead of exhausting) is a distinct, searchable mechanic with no existing tag. A whole cycle does this: Anchor Chain (11081), Hand Hook (11082), Nautical Charts (11084) all read 'While X is in your hand, you may perform the below "[action]" ability. If you do, discard X instead of exhausting it.'

Searching your COLLECTION (your entire card pool outside the deck), not your deck/discard/encounter deck, is a distinct tutor mechanic. The existing DeckSearch* range covers deck/discard/encounter only. Memories of Another Life (11125) 'search your collection for any non-permanent level 0 card ... Play that card at no cost'; Transfiguration (11076) 'Choose another investigator card from your collection.' Rare but a genuinely different fetch space.

Resolving a Fight ability on a weapon that is discarded/revealed from hand (or that just left play), ignoring all costs, without ever putting the asset into play, is a recurring 'free attack from a weapon you don't deploy' archetype. Robert Castaigne (11051) 'Discard a [[Firearm]] asset ... Resolve a Fight ability on the discarded asset, ignoring all costs.'; Robert Castaigne (11062) 'Reveal a [[Firearm]] asset ... Resolve a Fight ability on the revealed asset, ignoring all costs.'; Remington Model 1858 (11022/11032) 'Immediately trigger the above [action] ability, ignoring all costs.' No existing tag captures triggering another card's ability for free.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that manipulate which chaos tokens come out of the bag during skill tests — revealing extra tokens and choosing/ignoring, cancelling a revealed token and redrawing, dynamically sealing a revealed token, ignoring or treating token effects, or revealing-until-a-symbol. Players search these together as 'chaos bag control / scrying' tech.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: This pack is saturated with chaos-bag control that already maps to several existing base tags but is never grouped. Dial of Ancients (11048) 'reveal X additional tokens ... Choose 1 ... to resolve and ignore the rest'; Eyes of the Dreamer (11067) & Breath of the Sleeper (11066) same; Uncanny Specimen (11039) 'Cancel that chaos token, return it to the chaos bag, and reveal a new one'; Correlate All Its Contents (11040) 'cancel the first chaos token revealed ... and reveal a new one'; Katarina Sojka (11069) 'Reveal tokens ... until a token with a symbol is revealed. Resolve that token and ignore the rest'; Ocula Obscura (11009) dynamic seal. A compound tag lets deckbuilders find the whole archetype.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that derive value from being in, played from, or returned out of the discard pile — playable directly from discard, scaling off copies in discard, or recurring themselves from discard. A 'self-recursion / discard matters' archetype.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: A distinct cluster in tdc rewards a stocked discard pile: Profane Idol (11085) 'can only be played from your discard pile'; Improvised Weapon (11092) 'You may play Improvised Weapon from your discard pile. If you do, shuffle it into your deck ... and draw 1 card'; A Glimmer of Hope (11090) 'Add all copies of A Glimmer of Hope in your discard pile to your hand'; Quick-Witted (11042) 'gains [intellect] [agility] for each other copy of Quick-Witted in your discard pile.' Players build around this together.

archetypes.name: Chaos-bag scrying / token control
archetypes.description: Reveal extra chaos tokens and pick the best (ignoring the rest), cancel-and-redraw a revealed token, reveal-until-symbol, or seal a just-revealed token — all to control test outcomes. Heavily represented; mostly maps to existing ChaosRevealMore + ChaosEffectResolveChoose + ChaosRevealAnotherInstead, plus the proposed ChaosSealRevealedToken.

archetypes.name: Inspiration / token-payoff economy
archetypes.description: Assets fueled by a per-card use token (inspiration, also shell, leads) replenished on triggers and spent for +/-1 skill value or actions. New use-token types absent from the uses enums.

archetypes.name: Discard-from-hand engine + in-hand abilities
archetypes.description: Cards that pay a hand-discard cost or activate their action while still in hand (discarding instead of exhausting), pairing with payoffs that trigger 'after you discard cards from hand' (Lawrence Carlisle 11083, Ample Supplies 11089). The in-hand-action piece needs the proposed ActionFromHand.

archetypes.name: Free weapon attack without deploying
archetypes.description: Resolve a weapon's Fight ability for free off a card discarded/revealed from hand or just leaving play, never deploying the asset. Needs proposed ResolveFightOnRevealedAsset.

archetypes.name: Ready / action-economy support
archetypes.description: Readying your own or another investigator's assets/allies to act again, and granting additional actions. Additional-action half is covered by ActionAdditional; the readying half needs the proposed ReadyAsset.

archetypes.name: Self-inflicted threat-area weakness with conditional shuffle-back
archetypes.description: Weaknesses that enter the threat area and shuffle back into the deck (taking horror/damage) unless you met a per-round condition (investigate/evade/fight/draw). A consistent weakness design family, not a buildable archetype — noted for completeness, not tagged.

coverageNotes: Analyzed 123 cards. EXISTING TAXONOMY ALREADY COVERS WELL: (1) The big 'reveal more chaos tokens, choose 1, ignore the rest' archetype = ChaosRevealMore + ChaosEffectResolveChoose (verified against Grotesque Statue 01571), so Dial of Ancients 11048, Breath of the Sleeper 11066, Eyes of the Dreamer 11067, Forbidden Sutra 11103 are covered. (2) Cancel-a-revealed-token-and-redraw = CancelChaos + ChaosRevealAnotherInstead (Uncanny Specimen 11039, Correlate 11040, Dial 11047). (3) Granting additional actions = ActionAdditional (verified meaning via Leo De Luca / Police Badge) — covers Antikythera 11049, Blood of Thoth 11065, Captivating Performance 11108. (4) Cancel damage/horror = CancelDamage/CancelHorror ('You've had worse' 11054/11063, Spectral Shield 11071). (5) Cancel attack on enemy = CancelAttack/compoundAttackMitigation (Bulwark 11028, Misdirection 11043, Trench Armor 11113). (6) Enemy mitigation back-to-encounter-deck / defeat = EnemyMitigationBackToEncounterDeck/Defeat (Intimidation 11056, Whispers of Doom 11072, Name Your Price 11105). (7) Place charges/secrets on other assets ('battery') = UsesSupportCharge/Secret with supportType:'place' (Correlate 11040, Enraptured 11077, Lost Arcana 11078, Mortar 11037). (8) Additional hand slots restricted to a trait = SlotAdditionalHand ('Viola' Case 11012, Scientific Studies Grant 11044) — trait restriction is just a filter. (9) Search top-N of deck = DeckSearchYou with range top ('Viola' Case 11012). (10) Cost reduction = CostDiscount (Primed for Action 11023, Quick Shot 11031). (11) Parley-action cards = ActionBoldParley. (12) Prevent enemy readying next upkeep = EnemyDoesNotReady (Anchor Chain 11081, 'Catch!' 11086). (13) succeed/fail-by-exactly payoff matrices = SkillValueSucceedByExactly/TestSucceedBy (Antikythera 11049, Book of Verse 11005, Alton O'Connell 11033). AMBIGUITIES / JUDGMENT CALLS I COULD NOT FULLY RESOLVE: (a) 'Spend secrets/resources on X to pay for [[Spell]]/[[Insight]] cards' (Mortar 11037, Lost Arcana 11078, Archibald MacVeigh 11117) — an alternative-resource-pool/battery mechanic; partly overlaps TraitSupport* but the 'spend-as-resource-substitute' aspect isn't cleanly captured; left unproposed pending a global view. (b) Token-counting payoffs that scale with number/type of revealed tokens (Confidence 11097 'for each additional chaos token revealed ... gains [wild]'; Storm Ruler 11115 'for each [skull],[cultist],[tablet],[elder_thing] symbol revealed ... deal 1 damage') — a reward-for-revealing-more sub-mechanic tied to chaos-token-control; flagged but not proposed as a tag (only ~2 cards). (c) Cost-as-bonus pump ('Catch!' 11086, Unconventional Method 11087: '+X where X is the chosen asset's printed resource cost') — distinct from StatsModPump (which scales by resources/charges spent), but only a 2-card cycle. (d) Remote ability resolution 'as if you were there' (Spiritual Echo 11075, Doppelganger 11058) and 'play with top of encounter deck revealed' (Eye of Ghatanothoa 11073) and encounter-draw control (Deliverance 11079) — niche, left unproposed. (e) 'Cards beneath investigator' swap mechanics (Grim Resolve 11018, Cast Adrift 11019) are investigator-signature-specific, not buildable, so untagged.

args.name: putIntoPlay
args.type: boolean (true if the fetched bonded card is put directly into play / added to hand; false if it is shuffled into the deck)

proposedTags.rationale: TDE introduces the bonded mechanic and a huge cluster of cards whose core game effect is 'search your bonded cards for X' — fetching a card that is set aside out of play (NOT in your deck/discard/encounter deck). The existing TagTypeDeckSearch tags are explicitly modeled with a range of 'all' / top N / bottom N of a deck and cannot express fetching set-aside bonded cards, which is the searchable thing a deckbuilder looks for ('what summons my bonded payoff?'). Gate Box: 'search your bonded cards for Dream-Gate ... put it into play'; Miss Doyle: 'Search your bonded cards for Hope, Zeal, and Augur'; Empty Vessel: 'Search your bonded cards for Wish Eater and swap it'; Summoned Hound additional cost: 'search your bonded cards for 1 copy of Unbound Beast and shuffle it into your deck'.

args.name: stat
args.type: SkillType (the stat whose value is added, e.g. willpower)

args.name: action
args.type: TestingBasicAction? (fight / evade / investigate that the addition applies to)

proposedTags.rationale: Several cards add an entire second stat's value ON TOP of the base skill for a specific action — this is the 'use willpower for everything' / Mystic-flex archetype and is distinct from the existing TagTypeBuffStatsReplace (a passive from->to REPLACEMENT). Here you keep the action's normal stat and ADD willpower. Read the Signs: 'Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this investigation'; Ethereal Form: 'Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this evasion attempt'; Spectral Razor: 'Add your [willpower] value to your skill value for this attack.' The old regex hints even tag these as stat_add_willpower_for_* but no real tag exists in the taxonomy.

Active disengagement (a card effect that makes you disengage from enemies already engaged with you) is a distinct evasion/escape effect not captured by the existing engage tags (EnemyEngageNone is about preventing engagement / engaging no one; the existing tags model who engages whom, not the act of breaking an existing engagement). Gate Box: 'Disengage from each enemy engaged with you'; Ethereal Form: 'disengage from each other enemy engaged with you'. Belongs in tags/enemy/engage.ts.

args.name: value
args.type: number (amount of difficulty reduction; use -1 / special for dynamic/X)

proposedTags.rationale: Momentum reduces the DIFFICULTY of a future test, which is mechanically distinct from the existing boost/stats-mod tags (which raise your skill value) and from skill-value success/fail-margin tags. 'reduce the difficulty of the next skill test you perform this phase by X, where X is the amount this skill test succeeded by (to a maximum of 3).' No existing tag expresses lowering test difficulty. Conservatively a single-card occurrence in this pack, but a recurring effect family worth naming for global synthesis.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards whose payoff is fetching/summoning a bonded (set-aside, out-of-play) card into play, into hand, or shuffled into the deck — the signature engine of TDE investigators. Players search this archetype together when building around a bonded combo piece.
memberTagConcepts: TagTypeRecursion (when the fetched bonded card is an asset/event/skill set aside)
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: A large, distinct cluster in this pack centers on bonded cards: Gate Box->Dream-Gate, Segment of Onyx->Pendant of the Queen, Crystallizer of Dreams->Guardian, Miss Doyle->Hope/Zeal/Augur, Empty Vessel->Wish Eater, Summoned Hound->Unbound Beast, Dream Diary->Essence of the Dream, Nightmare Bauble->Dream Parasite. These share the broader archetype 'this card brings my out-of-play bonded card online' and would be searched together.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards that manipulate the chaos bag / chaos-token resolution: checking what symbol is revealed for a bonus, choosing an alternative resolution, or cancelling a revealed token. The classic 'chaos bag tech' deckbuilding package.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: This pack has a coherent chaos-token-control sub-theme: .35 Winchester ('If a +1, 0, or [elder_sign] chaos token is revealed ... deals +2 damage'), Wish Eater ('When you reveal a [skull]/[cultist]/[tablet]/[elder_thing] ... Cancel that token'), Nightmare Bauble ('When you reveal an [auto_fail] chaos token ... Cancel that token'), The Black Cat (reveal [tablet]/[elder_thing]/[elder_sign] and choose alternate effects). These span reveal-check, cancel, and resolve-choose base tags but no compound groups the chaos-bag-tech archetype that players search together.

proposedCompoundTags.conceptDescription: Cards whose primary searchable payoff is drawing cards for yourself or the team (often bundled with resource gain) — the 'card advantage / draw engine' deckbuilding package.
proposedCompoundTags.rationale: A recurring whole-game archetype well represented here: Scroll of Prophecies ('That investigator draws 3 cards'), Easy Mark ('Gain 2 resources and draw 1 card'), Three Aces ('draw 3 cards and gain 3 resources'), Self-Sacrifice ('either you draw 2 cards, or the performing investigator draws 2 cards'), Dream-Enhancing Serum ('Draw 1 card'). Grouping the draw base tags as an explicit 'draw economy' archetype helps later global synthesis size the card-advantage gap.

archetypes.name: Bonded-card summoning engine
archetypes.description: TDE's defining mechanic: a deck card sets aside / fetches a bonded card from out of play and puts it into play, into hand, or shuffles it into the deck. Often a multi-step engine (small enabler -> big payoff) and frequently combined with myriad/limit-1 constraints.

archetypes.name: Willpower-flex / add-a-stat tests
archetypes.description: Mystic-leaning cards that let you perform fight/evade/investigate using willpower added to (or substituted for) the normal stat, letting a high-willpower investigator do everything. Includes add-stat (Read the Signs, Ethereal Form, Spectral Razor) and substitute-stat (Mind's Eye 'Test your [willpower] instead', Empower Self 'use [willpower] instead of [combat]').

archetypes.name: Chaos-bag tech
archetypes.description: Cards that read, redirect, or cancel revealed chaos tokens for a bonus or to dodge bad symbols.

archetypes.name: Myriad self-replicating value
archetypes.description: Myriad cards (deck limit 3, often play another copy / commit multiple copies) that snowball draw, resources, clues, or auto-success. Easy Mark / Tony's .38 chain extra copies; Three Aces auto-succeeds when 3 are committed; Fortuitous Discovery scales off discard-pile copies; A Glimmer of Hope / Solemn Vow / Segment of Onyx use myriad packaging.

archetypes.name: Extra/immediate action grant
archetypes.description: Cards that grant an additional action or an immediate out-of-turn action, accelerating tempo. Covered by the existing TagTypeActionAdditional, noted here for archetype completeness.

coverageNotes:
Pack tde is the Dream-Eaters investigator expansion (60 player cards, codes 06006-06332). The existing taxonomy already covers a LOT of this pack well, so the true gap is small: uses/charges/ammo/secrets/bounties (UsesStarting*/UsesSupport*), the bold action keywords (ActionBold*), combat/intellect/agility boosts (StatsModBoostInTest*), damage-plus, deck restriction / limit-per-deck (DeckRestriction), fast/free/reaction costs and exhaust-self (CostFast/Free/Reaction*), draw and resource gain (DeckDraw*, GainResource*), search of deck/discard/top-N (DeckSearch* with range), clue discovery (ClueDiscover*/ClueAdditional*), heal (Heal*), chaos-token reveal-check and cancel (ChaosRevealToken*, CancelChaos, ChaosEffectResolveChoose), recursion of assets/events/skills (Recursion*), discard-pile-to-hand (DiscardPileToHand, e.g. Scrounge for Supplies, Scavenging, A Glimmer of Hope), succeed-by margins (SkillValue*/TestSucceedBy), additional/immediate actions (ActionAdditional, e.g. Haste, The Stars Are Right), and the trait-support tags (Item/Firearm/Spell/Tome/Practiced). 'Does not provoke attacks of opportunity' (Followed 06114) and 'cancel a revelation effect' (Fool me once... 06156 -> CancelRevelation already exists) are intentionally minor / already covered, so I did NOT propose new tags there.

GENUINE GAPS proposed: (1) fetching bonded/set-aside cards — the signature TDE archetype, not expressible by DeckSearch (which is deck-ranged); (2) ADD-a-stat-to-test (Read the Signs / Ethereal Form / Spectral Razor 'Add your [willpower] value to your skill value'), distinct from the passive from->to BuffStatsReplace; (3) active disengage (Gate Box, Ethereal Form 'Disengage from each enemy engaged with you'); (4) reduce next test's DIFFICULTY (Momentum), distinct from boosting your skill value.

AMBIGUITIES I could not fully resolve: (a) Stat SUBSTITUTION cases — Mind's Eye 'Test your [willpower] instead' and Empower Self 'use [willpower] instead of [combat]' — are close to BuffStatsReplace but are active/optional per-test rather than a passive from->to; unclear whether to reuse BuffStatsReplace, treat as the add-stat tag's sibling, or make a separate replace-in-test tag. I leaned toward NOT proposing a new tag for substitution and grouping it only in the willpower-flex archetype. (b) Sawed-Off Shotgun (06327) deals 'damage equal to amount you succeed by' and Delilah O'Rourke (06281) deals testless damage scaling off the enemy's evade value / exhausted state — these damage-on-success-margin and X-cost-scaled-damage patterns are not cleanly captured by DamagePlus (fixed value) or TestlessDamage*, but each is a near-singleton here so I held off proposing; flag for global synthesis if they recur. (c) 'Place charges/ammo onto another asset' refill effects (Swift Reload 06161, Twila 06244) are partially covered by UsesSupport* (supportType 'place'); confirm those cards get UsesSupportAmmo/Charge tags rather than needing anything new.
